Vegetarian meal plans in Dubai

By the Messify team · Updated November 2026 · 6 min read

Quick answer

Messify has a vegetarian option every day, for every meal, so you can eat vegetarian for your whole plan or only when you want to. Every meal is 100% halal, allergens are listed on each one, and the vegetarian option costs the same as any other meal: from AED 25 a meal. Our partner kitchen cooks both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, so it is not a pure-vegetarian kitchen.

Two kinds of vegetarian meal plan

If you search for a vegetarian meal plan in Dubai, you will find two quite different things. The first is a dedicated vegetarian diet plan: every meal is meat-free, often built around calorie or nutrition targets, and usually priced per day. The second is an everyday meal plan with a vegetarian choice at every meal, where you pick the vegetarian dish whenever you want it.

Messify is the second kind. There is a vegetarian option every day, for every meal: breakfast, lunch and dinner. You can eat vegetarian every day of your plan, or only on the days you feel like it. If you want a strict diet programme with nutrition targets, a specialist diet plan is the better fit; our comparison of meal plans in Dubai lists providers that sell dedicated vegetarian plans.

What to check before you choose

"Vegetarian" can mean different things to different people, so ask these questions before you pay for any plan:

  • Is there a vegetarian choice at every meal, or only some days? A plan that only has a vegetarian lunch leaves you sorting breakfast and dinner yourself.
  • Does the kitchen also cook meat? Many kitchens cook both. If you only eat food from a pure-vegetarian kitchen, or you follow a Jain diet, ask this first.
  • Are eggs and dairy used? If you are vegan or avoid eggs or dairy, check the ingredients and allergens on each dish, and ask about anything that isn't clear.
  • Does the menu change? The same three vegetarian dishes on repeat is how most people give up on a plan after two weeks.
  • Can you skip a day? If you eat with family or friends some days, you don't want to pay for meals you won't eat.
  • Does the vegetarian option cost extra? Check the price per meal, not just the headline price.

How vegetarian meals work on a Messify plan

Every day the menu changes, and every meal has a vegetarian option alongside the other dishes. Our menu mixes Indian, Arabic and Continental dishes, so the vegetarian choices change through the week too.

  1. Choose a plan in the Messify app: 1, 2 or 3 meals a day, weekly or monthly.
  2. Pick tomorrow's meals by 6 PM. You see the next day's menu in the app and choose the vegetarian option for any meal you like. Orders are always placed at least a day ahead.
  3. Check the allergens. Allergens are listed on each meal, so you can see what is in a dish before you choose it.
  4. Get your meals, chilled, then keep them in the fridge and reheat them when you're ready to eat.

Each meal on your plan is a token. A vegetarian meal uses one token, the same as any other meal. If you are away or eating out one day, skip it in the app and use that meal on another day of your plan.

Is the kitchen pure vegetarian?

No, and it's worth being clear about this. All Messify meals are cooked fresh daily in our partner kitchen in International City, and that kitchen cooks both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. The vegetarian option is a meat-free dish, but it is not cooked in a separate pure-vegetarian kitchen. If you only eat food from a pure-vegetarian kitchen, or you need Jain meals, message us on WhatsApp before you start: we'd rather you know exactly what you're getting than find out later.

Every Messify meal, vegetarian or not, is 100% halal. Our halal meal plans guide explains more.

Who a vegetarian-friendly plan suits

  • Vegetarians who are happy with a shared kitchen and want breakfast, lunch and dinner sorted without cooking.
  • Flatmates, couples and colleagues where one person eats vegetarian and the other doesn't. Each person picks their own meals from the same daily menu.
  • People eating less meat. Pick the vegetarian option a few days a week for a lighter day. Our healthy meal plans guide has more ideas.
  • Students who want a fixed food cost for the semester. See student meal plans in Dubai.

What it costs

There is no extra charge for vegetarian meals. Prices start from AED 25 a meal:

  • Weekly: AED 215, 415 or 610 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day (7 days of meals to use within 9 days).
  • Monthly: AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day (26 days of meals to use within 30 days).

That works out at AED 25.63 to 30.71 per meal, depending on the plan. Our meal plan cost guide compares this with ordering in, and weekly vs monthly helps you pick a length.

Where Messify delivers

In Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City and Dubai Festival City (including Al Badia), all of the day's meals arrive together every morning in one chilled bag.

We also deliver to Al Aweer, Dubai Investments Park (DIP), Jebel Ali (including JAFZA), Al Furjan and Dubai South. Meals arrive chilled with ice packs, ready to keep in the fridge and reheat, and our team confirms the delivery details with you on WhatsApp.

How to start

Orders aren't taken on this website. Download the Messify app and choose your plan there, or message us on WhatsApp and our team will answer any questions about the vegetarian dishes before you start. See every plan and price on our meal plans in Dubai page, or start your plan.

Planning an event with vegetarian guests? Vegetarian dishes can go into any of our catering menus.

Questions people ask

Does Messify have a vegetarian meal plan?

Messify has a vegetarian option every day, for every meal: breakfast, lunch and dinner. You can choose the vegetarian dish at every meal, so you can eat vegetarian for your whole plan.

Is the Messify kitchen pure vegetarian?

No. Our partner kitchen in International City cooks both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. If you need a pure-vegetarian kitchen or Jain meals, message us on WhatsApp before you start.

Do vegetarian meals cost more?

No. A vegetarian meal uses one token, the same as any other meal. Plans start from AED 25 a meal: AED 215 a week or AED 715 a month for 1 meal a day.

Can I see the allergens before I choose?

Yes. Allergens are listed on each meal, and you choose tomorrow's meals in the app by 6 PM the day before.

Are the vegetarian meals halal?

Yes. Every Messify meal is 100% halal, vegetarian or not.

Which areas do you deliver vegetarian meal plans to?

Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City, Dubai Festival City (DFC), Al Aweer, Dubai Investments Park (DIP), Jebel Ali (including JAFZA), Al Furjan and Dubai South.
